_comment: Each entry is generation parameters only - no hand-authored prose. Narrative/geometry are fully procedural (see scripts/generate-floors.mjs). `id` is optional (defaults to a slug of `name`); `complexityTier` (1-5) overrides the tier normally derived from `floorNumber` (~2 floors per tier). `themeCategory` must match a key in data/narrative-lexicon.json's themeCategories, or is picked at random from the seed if omitted.
